alt: Row of white Waymo autonomous robotaxis with sensor domes on their roofs, parked on a San Francisco city street
story: On July 4, 2026, Waymo robotaxis drove directly into lit fireworks in San Francisco, gridlocked for hours as batteries ran out, and had to be towed — while the company's handful of remote operators couldn't unstick dozens of stalled cars at once.
why_funny: The car designed to remove human error drove into explosives because there was no human to say 'maybe don't.'
